patthana15.26:1.1: Nahetuṃ sahetukaṃ kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nahetu nasahetuko nakusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Hetuyā ekaṃ.
patthana15.26:2.1: Nahetuṃ sahetukaṃ akusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nahetu nasahetuko naakusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Hetuyā ekaṃ.
patthana15.26:3.1: Nahetuṃ ahetukaṃ abyākataṃ dhammaṃ paccayā nahetu naahetuko naabyākato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Hetuyā ekaṃ.
